On a spirited night, rules for the day crew
This section explains the steps for the whole desk
Companion Animal Travel Desk Service Standards

The purpose of this section is to keep companion animal travel support clear, calm, and consistent across Aurelia Skyways.

Staff at the Companion Animal Travel Desk must answer every inquiry in a warm professional tone, keep records current, and guide travelers through the normal review process without drift or guesswork. When a passenger brings up a concern, listen first, note the issue carefully, and move the conversation toward the next practical step. If a traveler asks about cabin handling, explain that the cabin team monitors animals during flight and that the desk supports the booking and check-in side of the journey. Keep language plain, direct, and free of pressure.

All requests must be checked against the travel file before any promise is made. Confirm that the animal details, carrier information, and route notes match the reservation, and then update the record if anything has changed. If a form is incomplete or a document is unclear, say so at once and request the missing detail before the case advances. Do not rely on memory when the file is available. Do not leave an open item without a note in the log.

The desk should treat every traveler with steady courtesy, including those who arrive worried, rushed, or unsure of the process. If a passenger seems unsettled, slow the pace, repeat the key points, and offer a clear path forward. For example, if Elena Brown or Mariam Osei calls about a pet such as Skye, the response should remain calm and factual, with the same care given to every traveler. Keep private information protected and share it only with staff who need it to complete the service task.

When the issue moves beyond routine support, pass it to the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor without delay. Seek guidance whenever the case falls outside ordinary desk handling, when the traveler disputes a requirement, or when the cabin team reports a concern that changes the plan. Accurate notes, courteous speech, and timely handoff protect the traveler and support smooth service across Aurelia Skyways. Contact the duty supervisor for unresolved concerns or any matter that needs escalation.
